composition.serve_who: Sheet 21 (SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg, section AFT) is an index/detail page in the AFT PLC rack set. It details three WAGO 750-508 2-channel digital-output modules at rack positions 13, 14, 15 (DO-03, DO-04, DO-05), each energising a pair of solenoid pilots for one piece of AFT hydraulic equipment: transom door (EV-10.1A/B), deck door (EV-10.2A/B), and mainsheet traveller (EV-10.3A/B). Equipment identity is read directly from the printed function labels next to each channel, matching the register's engineer-confirmed mapping (transom door -> 260-transom-door, deck door -> 260-deck-door, mainsheet traveller -> 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders). The rack itself (coupler, module types/positions, bus) is shared AFT PLC infrastructure and is recorded on the rack node, not on the served equipment.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channel labels 'transom door CLOSE (EV 10.1A)' and 'transom door OPEN (EV 10.1B)' directly name this equipment; EV-10.1 is already established on the hydraulic sheet (AFT_blockC) as a PVEO ON/OFF actuated door valve with 125/195 bar relief on A/B work ports.

functions.label: Transom door open/close solenoid control
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital outputs energise the two solenoid pilots of the transom door hydraulic valve (EV-10.1), commanding the door closed or open. No local switch or fuse is shown on this sheet — the PLC output is the sole control path drawn.
functions.sheet_region: left column, POS.13 module (approx bbox 0.19-0.29 x 0.14-0.55)
key_components: 4-pin circular Connector Type I (field connector, detailed on sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: Both DO-03 channels off -> no coil energised -> transom door valve spool centred, door holds last position (relief valves on A/B ports, per hydraulic sheet, protect against over-pressure at either end of travel)

PLC DO-03 channel 1 (CH01) energised, voltage taken relative to module common/A1-A2 supply terminals -> output + / - pair drives solenoid coil EV-10.1A via Connector Type I pin pair -> transom door hydraulic valve shifts to CLOSE side -> door drives closed

PLC DO-03 channel 2 (CH02) energised, voltage relative to module common -> output + / - pair drives solenoid coil EV-10.1B via Connector Type I -> transom door valve shifts to OPEN side -> door drives open

functions.dry_data: Module: WAGO 750-508 2DO, CPU 750-8213, rack POS.13, output DO-03 CH01/CH02, field pilot type PVEO (per hydraulic-sheet cross-reference, keep as PVEO not generic solenoid).

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channel labels 'deck door OPEN (EV 10.2A)' and 'deck door CLOSE (EV 10.2B)' directly name this equipment; matches register mapping to 260-deck-door.

functions.label: Deck door open/close solenoid control
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital outputs energise the two solenoid pilots of the deck door hydraulic valve (EV-10.2), commanding the door open or closed. No local switch or fuse is shown on this sheet — control originates purely from the PLC output.
functions.sheet_region: middle column, POS.14 module (approx bbox 0.48-0.58 x 0.14-0.55)
key_components: 4-pin circular Connector Type I (field connector, detailed on sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: Both DO-04 channels off -> no coil energised -> deck door valve spool centred, door holds last position

PLC DO-04 channel 1 (CH01) energised, voltage relative to module common -> output + / - pair drives solenoid coil EV-10.2A via Connector Type I -> deck door valve shifts to OPEN side -> door drives open

PLC DO-04 channel 2 (CH02) energised, voltage relative to module common -> output + / - pair drives solenoid coil EV-10.2B via Connector Type I -> deck door valve shifts to CLOSE side -> door drives closed

functions.dry_data: Module: WAGO 750-508 2DO, CPU 750-8213, rack POS.14, output DO-04 CH01/CH02. Pilot device type for EV-10.2 not established on an ingested hydraulic sheet in this set — treat as EV solenoid pilot per this sheet only.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Channel labels 'mainsheet traveler TO PORT (EV 10.3A)' and 'mainsheet traveler TO STBD (EV 10.3B)' match the register's engineer-confirmed alias 'mainsheet traveller -> 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders'.

functions.label: Mainsheet traveller port/starboard solenoid control
functions.what_it_does: PLC digital outputs energise the two solenoid pilots of the mainsheet traveller hydraulic valve (EV-10.3), driving the traveller car to port or to starboard. No local switch or fuse is shown on this sheet — control originates purely from the PLC output.
functions.sheet_region: right column, POS.15 module (approx bbox 0.76-0.86 x 0.14-0.55)
key_components: 4-pin circular Connector Type I (field connector, detailed on sheet 4)

flow_scenarios.path: Both DO-05 channels off -> no coil energised -> traveller valve spool centred, car holds position

PLC DO-05 channel 1 (CH01) energised, voltage relative to module common -> output + / - pair drives solenoid coil EV-10.3A via Connector Type I -> traveller valve shifts to PORT side -> mainsheet traveller car moves to port

PLC DO-05 channel 2 (CH02) energised, voltage relative to module common -> output + / - pair drives solenoid coil EV-10.3B via Connector Type I -> traveller valve shifts to STBD side -> mainsheet traveller car moves to starboard

functions.dry_data: Module: WAGO 750-508 2DO, CPU 750-8213, rack POS.15, output DO-05 CH01/CH02. Pilot device type for EV-10.3 not established on an ingested hydraulic sheet in this set — treat as EV solenoid pilot per this sheet only.

infrastructure.system_name: AFT PLC I/O Rack (WAGO) — DO section
facts: Three 2-channel digital-output modules WAGO 750-508 at rack positions 13 (DO-03), 14 (DO-04), 15 (DO-05); CPU/bus coupler 750-8213 common to all.
Each module has A1/A2 bus supply terminals and per-channel +/- output pairs feeding ground/earth terminals before the field connector.
Each module's two channels feed a 4-pin circular field connector labelled 'Connector Type I' — pinout/mating detail is on sheet 4 (cross-reference, not detailed here).
This page functions as a rack-detail page (not the rack GA/index) within the AFT PLC set — it documents module positions 13-15 only; earlier/later positions are on other pages of the set.

cross_references.what: Connector Type I 4-pin field connector pinout/wiring for DO-03, DO-04, DO-05
EV-10.1 (transom door) hydraulic manifold detail, PVEO actuation, 125/195 bar relief on A/B ports
EV-10.2 (deck door) hydraulic manifold detail and pilot device type

good_to_have: Exact terminal numbering on Connector Type I (pins 1-4) — pinout detail is on sheet 4.
Module A1/A2 bus-supply terminal ratings not printed on this sheet; standard WAGO 750-508 spec available at inspection.
Ground/earth terminal symbol shown per channel before the field connector — role clear (protective earth), exact wiring detail at inspection.
uncertainties: Pilot device type (PVEO vs PVEU/PVED) for EV-10.2 (deck door) and EV-10.3 (mainsheet traveller) is not established by any ingested hydraulic sheet in the provided facts — only EV-10.1 (transom door) has a confirmed PVEO type. Recorded generically as 'EV solenoid pilot' here pending hydraulic-sheet cross-reference; do not assume PVEO/PVED/PVEU without that sheet.
